_meta.name: LTX 2.5 first-last-frame
_meta.purpose: Animate a pair of overhead keyframes. Partner node LtxApi25ImageToVideo on Comfy Cloud. Fast 720×1280 / 3s is the default studio setting.

inputs.20.prompt: Motion + audio between the two stills

inputs.prompt: Locked-off static top-down overhead camera, 90 degrees, no camera movement, no tilt, no zoom, no dolly, no cut. Both keyframes are strict 90-degree overhead plates. Only hands move. Bare adult hands enter from the bottom of frame and perform a slow ASMR unboxing motion that carries the scene from the first still to the last still. Fingers only, no faces, no torsos. Paper fiber, tape, and ceramic. Audio: close-mic paper, tape peel, soft ceramic tap, quiet room tone. No music, no voiceover, no logos.
